audience.title: Built for project and service businesses
audience.teamTitle: The team works together - each with the information they need
audience.teamBody: Invite workers and managers and define who sees projects, expenses, changes, and profitability. You can also hide areas that are not relevant to the business.

items.a: Project, job, and service businesses - contractors, renovation, trades, maintenance, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, and project managers.

items.q: Does it also fit architects, engineers, and consultants?
items.a: Yes. You can manage projects, documents, costs, and billing in consulting and design businesses - and leave irrelevant areas off.

items.q: Does it also fit a small business?
items.a: Yes. Start with clients, jobs, and basic expenses - without turning everything on.

items.q: Do I have to use every capability?
items.a: No. Turn on only what you need. A small business stays simple.

items.q: How do I know if a project is really profitable?
items.a: You see what it cost, what is still expected, what was billed and paid - and the profitability. You can also produce a financial report for a client without giving them system access.

items.q: Does the system warn when a project starts to overrun?
items.a: Yes. You can get a warning when profitability weakens, budget is under pressure, costs grow, or billing and collection lag.

items.q: Can I manage a bill of quantities?
items.a: Yes. You can build a BOQ, measure progress, manage changes, and issue progress bills - when the capability is turned on.
No. ProjectFlow manages the work and business profitability, and lets you keep and export information for accounting follow-up.
Yes. Photograph or upload an invoice, the system reads the main details and prepares a draft for review. You check before continuing.

items.q: Can I manage vendors and subcontractors?
items.a: Yes. Vendors, purchase orders, subcontractors, vendor bills, and payments can be linked to the work when you need them.

items.q: Can workers use it from a phone?
items.a: Yes. The same system is adapted for mobile - logs, expenses, and key information stay available in the field.

items.q: Can I produce reports for a client?
items.a: Yes. You can produce professional reports on project status, financial summary, progress, changes, and field work - without giving the client access to the system.

items.q: Can I quickly find clients, projects, and documents?
items.a: Yes. Quick search finds clients, projects, vendors, invoices, documents, employees, and work orders.

items.q: Does every worker see financials and profitability?
items.a: No. You set permissions - each person sees what they need.

items.q: Can I install ProjectFlow as an app?
items.a: Yes. Install from the browser to the home screen or desktop when the device supports it.

items.q: How is ProjectFlow different from a task manager?
items.a: A task manager tracks tasks. ProjectFlow connects the work to the money: costs, billing, collections, and profitability.
